commodity.label: Cocoa
commodity.definition: Cocoa beans, cocoa paste, cocoa butter and cocoa powder (HS 1801, 1803–1805). Excludes cocoa shells (1802) and chocolate (1806). Net mass adds beans and products as recorded, not converted to a bean equivalent.

cn8.description: Cocoa beans, whole or broken, raw or roasted
Cocoa paste, wholly or partly defatted
Cocoa powder, not containing added sugar or other sweetening matter
